description: Fetch metadata + a download URL for a single file by id. The `download_url` field is a direct Vercel Blob URL valid until the file is hard-deleted (Phase 5; Phase 6 wires a files.trydock.ai signed-URL minter with 5-min TTL + auth re-check). Useful for an agent reading file contents server-side (HTTP GET the URL) or surfacing a download link in a reply. Gated behind FILES_SURFACE_ENABLED + per-user allowlist.

file_id.description: The file cuid (from list_files). Surface + workspace are derived from the file row, so no surface_slug arg is needed.

slug.description: The workspace slug. Accepts either the bare slug or the org-prefixed form ('my-org/my-workspace') as shown in the dashboard URL.

name: get_file
